objective: Stop Android keyboard/layout jitter when typing in Formation Submission Report member feedback; keep input mounted, debounce lookup, reject stale cross-scope responses.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main ca8e7e508b13e197b0c86aaf3d275962d977d157 inspected on 2026-11-09; user screenshot shows cropped ATTENTION card and open Android keyboard, but installed app runtime, current production OTA and exact native reproduction are not verified.
acceptanceChecks: Member search typing never invokes full feedback refresh or unmounts focused text input
Debounce 250ms; stale search results and response errors after cleanup ignored
Existing feedback publications and selected member remain correct per exact workspace; reset on scope switch
Initial loading and refresh preserve existing feedback save functionality
Run focused Node tests and Engineering Accountability gate before any RC
Confirm keyboard open, repeated typing, scope switch, blur, scrolling and publish on real Android before release; no production OTA from this PR
chosenApproach: Scope-only split of feedback list refresh from debounced member lookup plus latest-only cancellation and stable initial-load form gate.
selectionRationale: Current useFocusEffect depends on load() which depends on memberQuery, so every keystroke sets loading true and removes the full input subtree; keyboard focus is lost and layout jumps. Decoupling the data sources fixes the actual lifecycle trigger without touching shared keyboard/nav components.
alternativeApproaches: Change global root KeyboardAvoidingView Android behavior: rejected pending evidence because broad impact on Connect, login, messages and other routes
Disable keyboard resize globally: rejected because it risks covered composers and Android accessibility
Debounce the full report reload: rejected because it still unmounts focused inputs after delay
preserveBehaviors: No modifications to Supabase persistence, RLS, exports or private admin scope access
No changes to global navigation, keyboard policy, Reels, Wall, Connect, ads or points
All-member and one-member feedback publication and existing-draft recall remain intact
No production release, OTA, SDK or runtime change in this isolated DEV branch
